import os, sys, re

unpacked = 'unpacked'
doc_path = os.path.join(unpacked, 'word', 'document.xml')

with open(doc_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

print("=== File size:", len(content), "bytes ===")
print("=== Number of <w:p> paragraphs:", content.count('<w:p>') + content.count('<w:p '))
print("=== Number of <w:tbl> tables:", content.count('<w:tbl>'))
print("=== Number of <w:sectPr>:", content.count('<w:sectPr'))

# Extract all paragraph text with pStyle info
paras = re.findall(r'<w:p\b.*?</w:p>', content, re.DOTALL)
print("\n=== PARAGRAPH LIST ===")
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    style = re.search(r'<w:pStyle w:val="([^"]+)"', p)
    texts = re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>', p)
    del_texts = re.findall(r'<w:delText[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:delText>', p)
    all_text = ' '.join(texts).strip()
    if del_texts:
        all_text += ' [DELETED: ' + ' '.join(del_texts) + ']'
    style_str = style.group(1) if style else ''
    if all_text or style_str:
        print(f"[{i}] style={style_str!r} text={all_text[:120]!r}")

# Show last section properties
print("\n=== LAST <w:sectPr> (tail of body) ===")
last_sect = content.rfind('<w:sectPr')
print(content[last_sect-200:last_sect+500])

# Check styles.xml for heading styles available
styles_path = os.path.join(unpacked, 'word', 'styles.xml')
if os.path.exists(styles_path):
    with open(styles_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        styles = f.read()
    styles_avail = re.findall(r'<w:style [^>]*w:styleId="([^"]+)"[^>]*>\s*<w:name w:val="([^"]+)"', styles)
    print("\n=== STYLES AVAILABLE (first 40) ===")
    for sid, name in styles_avail[:40]:
        print(f"  {sid}: {name}")

# Check for existing heading usage in document
print("\n=== HEADING STYLES USED IN DOC ===")
used_styles = set(re.findall(r'<w:pStyle w:val="([^"]+)"', content))
print(used_styles)

import os, re, sys

unpacked = 'unpacked'
doc_path = os.path.join(unpacked, 'word', 'document.xml')

try:
    with open(doc_path, 'rb') as f:
        raw = f.read()
    try:
        content = raw.decode('utf-8-sig')
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        content = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
except Exception as e:
    print("ERROR reading document.xml:", repr(e))
    sys.exit(1)

print("File size:", len(raw), "bytes")

# Strip XML tags for a rough text extraction
text_only = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', content)
print("Approx char count of visible text:", len(text_only))

# Count key elements

print("w:tbl count:", len(re.findall(r'<w:tbl[ >]', content)))
print("w:ins count:", len(re.findall(r'<w:ins[ >]', content)))
print("w:del count:", len(re.findall(r'<w:del[ >]', content)))
print("sectPr count:", len(re.findall(r'<w:sectPr', content)))

print("Paragraph styles used:", styles_used)

# Extract up to 40 paragraphs with their text, compactly

print("Total paragraphs:", len(paras))
print("--- first 40 paragraphs (style | text) ---")
shown = 0
for p in paras:
    style_m = re.search(r'<w:pStyle w:val="([^"]+)"', p)
    texts = re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>', p)
    dtexts = re.findall(r'<w:delText[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:delText>', p)

    if shown >= 40:

# Tail of document body before sectPr
idx = content.rfind('<w:sectPr')
if idx != -1:
    tail = content[max(0, idx-400):idx+200]
    print("--- tail before last sectPr (trimmed) ---")
    print(tail[-500:])
